program_open.value: No start code required; post guidelines say not to put % (or $) at the beginning or end of the program. O numbers only for subroutines (M98 O100 ...).
program_open.note: Differs from LinuxCNC, where % file demarcation is accepted (memory, unverified).

program_close.value: M30 = end and rewind; M2 = end, no rewind. Both reset to G54, G17, G90, G94, M48, G40, M05, G01 motion, M09 and clear axis offsets.

comment.value: Parentheses (...) inline, and ';' comments to end of line (';' inside parentheses is not a comment start). A comment may not sit between a letter and its number.
comment.note: S1 also shows (..) comments, case preserved inside.

line_numbers.value: Optional N + unsigned integer 0..99,999,999; may repeat/out of order. Program limited to 999,999 lines.

block_end.value: Newline ends the block; do not end blocks with ';'. Max 256 characters per line; blank lines ignored; case-insensitive outside comments.

safe_start.value: All supported: G90, G94, G17, G20/G21 (G21 mm), G40, G49, G80. No specific safe-start line is prescribed by Tormach in these pages. Any number of G words per line but not two of one modal group; up to four M words per line.

tool_change.value: T<n> M06 (or M06 T<n>, or T and M06 on separate lines; T must have been called before M6). Put G43 H<n> on the tool-change line, e.g. M06 T3 G43 H3. G30 before a tool change is highly recommended. Mill has 1000 tool offsets.
tool_change.where: Mill/Router section; M6 and G43 entries

tool_change_behaviour.value: With ATC and tool in carousel: automatic change. Without ATC (or tool not in carousel): M06 stops spindle, pauses the program and flashes the Tool Change LED; operator swaps and presses Cycle Start. No user macro needed.

tool_length_comp.value: G43 H<n> explicit (H should match T; not stated to default to the tool). Non-integer, negative or invalid H is an error.

spindle.value: S rpm with M03/M04/M05 (articles 'Spindle Control (M03, M04, and M05)' and 'Spindle Speed (S)').

work_offset.value: G54..G59 (1-6) plus G59.1, G59.2, G59.3 (7-9). Guidelines add that G54.1 P<n> is accepted (G54.1 P2 = G55).
work_offset.note: G54.1 from S3 'Deviations from Fanuc'; count of G54.1 P values UNKNOWN.

arc_format.value: G02/G03; I/J/K incremental from start by default (G91.1), G90.1 switches to absolute centre. R form exists in the supported list.
arc_format.note: Page wording is lathe-flavoured (I and K); J by analogy.

feed.value: F = feed rate; G94 units per minute (G20 in/min, G21 mm/min). G93 inverse time and G95 per rev exist.
feed.note: Per-minute wording from S16 (G94 = units per minute).

decimal_point.value: Number = optional sign, digits, optional single point; no implied-decimal scaling described, so X10 = 10 units in the active G20/G21 units.

max_digits.value: No digit-count limit; 17 significant figures kept; integer-required values accepted within 0.0001.

retract_home.value: G28 rapids (optionally via axis-word intermediate point) to the position stored with G28.1 in params 5161-5163 (machine coords, inches internally). G30 uses 5181-5186 and is recommended before tool changes. G53 G0 Z<n> = non-modal machine-coordinate move (needs G0 or G1 active; error with cutter comp). Guidelines: G28/G30 need G90 and comp off.
retract_home.note: G30 and G90 requirement from S3; G53 from S19.

coolant.value: M07 coolant (mist per guidelines, mill only), M08 flood, M09 all off. Smart Cool unit adds E/P/R/Q arguments. No through-spindle code.
coolant.note: Mist wording from S3 M-code table.

dwell.value: G04 P<seconds>, decimals allowed (G04 P4.2 = 4.2 s); negative P error.

drill_G81.value: G81 X Y Z R L (F modal); R/Z sticky; L repeat count, not sticky.
drill_G81.note: G81 page not fetched; format per general rules.

dwell_drill_G82.value: G82 X Y Z A R L P ; P dwell in seconds.

peck_G83.value: G83 X Y Z A R L Q ; Q incremental peck >0; rapid back to clear Z each peck.

chipbreak_G73.value: G73 X Y Z R L Q ; Q peck >0; fixed retract of 0.010 in between pecks; R required.

rigid_tap_G84.value: G84 X Y Z R P F ; spindle speed and M3 must be set before; F is the feed rate for in/out moves (relation to pitch not stated). P optional dwell in seconds (default 0.5 s per 1000 rpm). Feed override ignored. G98/G99 honoured. Left-hand G74 not supported.

bore_G85.value: G85 X Y Z A R L ; feed in, feed out.

return_level.value: G98 = back to original Z if above R else R; G99 = back to R (mill/router).

cycle_cancel.value: G80 cancels canned cycle / motion mode; call G00 or G01 before further axis words.

native_language.value: RS274NGC-style G-code shared with LinuxCNC plus Tormach additions; claims to follow most (~98%) of the Fanuc standard. No mode switch. Unsupported on mill: G07, G09, G12, G13, G52 (use G92), G74, G87 (G88 conflicting).
native_language.where: intro and 'Deviations from Fanuc' / unsupported list

notes: LinuxCNC-based. Differences documented by Tormach vs Fanuc: G54.1 P accepted, G92 shifts all offsets, G64 default P0.005 inch, no % marks. Differences vs LinuxCNC were not stated by Tormach; memory says LinuxCNC lacks G84 and G54.1 and accepts %-wrapped files (unverified). G73 retract is fixed 0.010 in.
